title: Forms gateway settings
description: Operator settings of the forms module; rendered into forms.yaml by the chart. Secrets are never settings (they come from the module's Secret).

trust_proxy.description: Use the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry (set by Traefik) as the client address. Enable only behind a proxy that appends the client address; never when the service is directly reachable.

text.description: The wording the visitor agrees to by ticking the box.

newsletter_consent.description: Adds an unticked checkbox named newsletter to these forms (specs/067-lead-adapters). Only a ticked box lets the newsletter adapter subscribe the sender.

notify_email.description: Who gets an email for every new submission. Sent through the platform's email.send; these addresses are also what can-core allows this module to mail (unless company.yaml email.modules.forms.recipients says otherwise).
